basic_info.description: Special Renovated Two-Level Home in Prime Bernal Heights Location on Rare, Large Lot. On coveted, tree-lined Bonview Streetjust steps north of Cortland's Village and situated on an unusually wide 33-foot lot - this beautifully renovated four-bedroom, three-bath home is the one you've been waiting for. A skylit entry flows to the open and expansive living, dining, and kitchen spaces -ideal for entertaining. The light-filled living room is lined with windows and anchored by a wood-burning Carrara marble fireplace, flowing into a spacious dining area. The professional kitchen offers a large island with breakfast bar, Carrara marble countertops, custom cabinetry, top-tier stainless appliances, a six-burner range, and abundant storage. Two garden-facing bedrooms and a full marble bath complete the main level. Downstairs, two more bedroomseach with en suite marble bathsoffer privacy and comfort. The primary suite opens to the garden and features a walk-in closet and oversized bath with soaking tub, double vanity, and walk-in shower. A hallway door leads to the lush patio and mature garden on the 2273 sq ft lot. Soaring ceilings, refinished wood floors, updated systems and foundation, a two-car tandem garage, and a 95 WalkScorethis rare find in Bernal Heights is the whole package!
